title: Use Case Artefact (v1.1.0)
description: A use case: a set of behaviours a subject performs that gives its actors an observable result of value toward an Outcome. Its scenarios are the paths through it; the scenario field holds the main success scenario in prose. It supports an outcome, requires capabilities, is fulfilled by product features and is realised by an architecture pattern.

requires_capabilities.description: The capabilities that make the use case possible: the demand that justifies them.

realised_by.description: The architecture patterns whose scenarios walk this use case's scenarios across building blocks, and the reference architectures that make them concrete. The inverse of serves on the pattern.

fulfilled_by_features.description: The product features that fulfil the use case. The inverse of fulfils on the feature.

allOf.$comment: Every use case names its actor, its outcome and its criteria, except a placeholder (portfolio.state placeholder), which has no content yet.
